search_window.basis: Conservative overlap from latest independently read verified Food Line heartbeat (00:44 PST); a later nominal 01:45 checkpoint could not be independently enumerated with the available repository file lookup. Search focuses new publication/event evidence and suppresses previously known stories.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary Food Line recall only; nationwide production collection remains authoritative; no claims of complete nationwide clearance.
target_classes: Loss/fire/disaster or closure of only/sole/last/full-service grocery
Emergency distribution canceled/suspended for storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate consequences
coverage_notes.search_engine: web fast, recency 2 days (engine may include historical results)

"last grocery store" closes November 2026 rural town
"full service grocery store" fire closure November 9 2026

failures.impact: Nonmaterial: current state SNAP/WIC notices in Oregon, Hawaiʻi, California and Georgia remained accessible; federal endpoint not cleared.

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Previously reported Nov 3, updated Nov 6; no new cancellation or change verified in the observation window.
Nov 9 provider post advertises Clark and Trempealeau County distributions, not cancellation. Previous Eau Claire change not newly announced.
Nov 6 recovery update lists upcoming mobile food distribution, not a new suspension.
Oregon documentation rule starts Nov 21, not an immediate access cutoff in this window.
Standing SNAP telephone application delays, no newly dated immediate interruption in the window.
California WIC notice dated Sep 2 states offices open and benefits continue.
Georgia EBT call center restored, no new outage as of this interval.
Georgia security restrictions effective Oct 22, not newly issued in this window.

coverage_notes.excluded_categories: Historic or out-of-country incidents; opening/restoration stories; donation requests, guides, generic inflation and promotion; already recorded disruptions; changes without verified immediate effect.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying source-backed disruption identified by 12 targeted web searches and 11 direct-source checks; 1 repeatedly unavailable USDA endpoint. A later nominal checkpoint could not be verified, so coverage begins at the last confirmed one with intentional overlap.
